A career in Indian shipbuilding

From the Indian Navy's engineering branch to founding Ganesha Marine and Industrial Fabrications.

1984 – 2002
Indian Navy

Chief Ship Wright Artificer

Eighteen years of service across multiple ships. Hull coordinator for docking/undocking, preparation of hull defect lists, and continuous monitoring to complete refits on schedule — including load testing of boat davits and anchor chain cable, and coordination with yards like WISL Goa, CSL Kochi and Naval Dockyards.

2002 – 2005
Siri Marine Pvt Ltd — Visakhapatnam & Kakinada

Ship repair & fabrication

Total planning and execution of repair works on board ships — renewal of shell, deck and bulkhead plating, railing and bull work — with direct coordination with ship owners for QC and work-done clearance.

2005 – 2007
Hindustan Shipyard Limited

Engineer (Production)

Played a key role in the medium refit of a submarine — preparing de-gutting/re-gutting procedures, material estimation, and coordinating with Russian hull specialists and third-party inspection agencies.

2007 – 2010
Shoft Shipyard & Alcock Shipyard

Project Manager — new construction

Built a 400-passenger ship, then led construction of two Offshore Supply Vessels (63m LOA, 1200 DWT) for Dolphin Offshore under Mauritius flag and ABS classification — coordinating bow thrusters, main engines, DGs, fire & safety systems, and compliance with SOLAS and the SPS code.

2010 – 2012
Waterways Shipyard Pvt Ltd — Karnataka

Senior Manager, Production

Overall in-charge, with a team of 3 engineers, 4 supervisors and 300 workmen, for new construction of twelve 2,500 DWT barges (74m LOA each) — hull, piping, machinery installation and outfitting. Carried out dry survey, inclining experiment and load line survey.

2012 – 2013
Infinite Shipping and Engg Pvt Ltd

Project Manager

Construction of two 25m-diameter steel caissons (seawater intake wells) for Gammon India / Hinduja Power Plant at Visakhapatnam, plus a 19m utility boat at Kakinada and further steel renewal work for a Voith tug at Vizag Port Trust.

2013 – 2016
Flash Forge Pvt Ltd — Visakhapatnam

Senior Manager, Projects (Marine Products)

Fabricated and delivered around 1,600 watertight/weathertight doors and hatches. Also led development of aluminium doors and hatches from scratch, delivered ahead of schedule.

2017 – 2020
SGS Marine Habitability Pvt Ltd

AGM (Production)

Delivered Indian Navy orders for doors and hatches to Naval Dockyard Karwar and Mumbai, dry dock doors and ATUs, and RC jobs at Naval Dockyard Visakhapatnam. Handled a 300-tonne structural job for Mazagon Dock, with regular stage inspections alongside CQAE(E), RINA and dockyard QC.

2020 – 2023
Ultra Dimensions Group

GM — Operations

  • Main coordinator for design, manufacture, supply, installation and commissioning of Caisson/Mitre Gates at Naval Dockyard Mumbai — approx. 2,000 tonnes, project value ₹117 crore.
  • Coordinated with IHQ, NAY Goa and Kochi on the Aviation Yard upgradation project; played a key role in bid preparation, emerging as L1 (lowest bidder / winning position) for a project worth approx. ₹414 crore.
  • Won the tender for manufacture and supply of six steel pontoons for DGNP(V), project value ₹33 crore.
2023 – 2024
Independent Technical Consultant

Tender preparation & project execution

Delivered strong foundations for L&T at Rambilli (approx. 60 tonnes) and a Single Point Mooring Buoy for the Indian Navy; bid and won a ₹150-tonne steel structural fabrication tender for L&T; overhauled main engine and generators on Tug Chowrasia, Odisha; fabricated Pyrotechnic and Scare Charge Lockers for Cochin Shipyard Ltd.

Dec 2024 – Present
Ganesha Marine and Industrial Fabrications

Managing Partner & Founder

Registered his own firm to bring twenty-five years of navy and shipyard leadership under one roof — now delivering dry-dock repair, new construction and structural fabrication for navy, port and commercial clients from Visakhapatnam.
